tools.name: zendesk_search
tools.description: Unified search across tickets, users, organizations and groups using Zendesk search syntax. Examples: `type:ticket status:open`, `type:user email:jane@acme.com`, `type:organization name:acme`. Zendesk REST: GET /search.json.

tools.name: zendesk_list_tickets
tools.description: List recent tickets (offset pagination). Zendesk REST: GET /tickets.json.

tools.name: zendesk_get_ticket
tools.description: Fetch a single ticket by id. Zendesk REST: GET /tickets/{id}.json.

tools.name: zendesk_list_ticket_comments
tools.description: List the comments (public replies and internal notes) on a ticket, oldest first. Zendesk REST: GET /tickets/{id}/comments.json.

tools.name: zendesk_current_user
tools.description: Return the currently authenticated user — a quick way to verify credentials and subdomain. Zendesk REST: GET /users/me.json.

tools.name: zendesk_get_user
tools.description: Fetch a single user by id. Zendesk REST: GET /users/{id}.json.

tools.name: zendesk_search_users
tools.description: Find users by name, email, phone, or other attributes. Zendesk REST: GET /users/search.json.

tools.name: zendesk_list_organizations
tools.description: List organizations (offset pagination). Zendesk REST: GET /organizations.json.

tools.name: zendesk_get_organization
tools.description: Fetch a single organization by id. Zendesk REST: GET /organizations/{id}.json.

tools.name: zendesk_list_groups
tools.description: List agent groups. Zendesk REST: GET /groups.json.

tools.name: zendesk_list_views
tools.description: List saved ticket views (curated ticket lists). Use zendesk_execute_view to run one. Zendesk REST: GET /views.json.

tools.name: zendesk_execute_view
tools.description: Run a saved view by id and return the matching tickets. Zendesk REST: GET /views/{id}/execute.json.

tools.name: zendesk_list_macros
tools.description: List macros (reusable sets of ticket actions/replies agents apply). Zendesk REST: GET /macros.json.

tools.name: zendesk_list_ticket_fields
tools.description: List all standard and custom ticket fields — useful for discovering field ids/values before creating or updating tickets. Zendesk REST: GET /ticket_fields.json.

tools.name: zendesk_get_ticket_metrics
tools.description: Fetch SLA / response / resolution time metrics for a ticket. Zendesk REST: GET /tickets/{id}/metrics.json.

tools.name: zendesk_list_satisfaction_ratings
tools.description: List customer satisfaction (CSAT) ratings, optionally filtered by score. Zendesk REST: GET /satisfaction_ratings.json.

tools.name: zendesk_create_ticket
tools.description: MUTATING: create a new support ticket. `subject` and `comment_body` are required; the comment becomes the ticket's first message. Zendesk REST: POST /tickets.json.

tools.name: zendesk_update_ticket
tools.description: MUTATING: update an existing ticket. Provide the ticket `id` plus at least one field to change (status, priority, assignee_id, group_id, type, tags, or a comment). Zendesk REST: PUT /tickets/{id}.json.

tools.name: zendesk_add_ticket_comment
tools.description: MUTATING: add a comment to a ticket. `public` defaults to true (a reply visible to the requester); set it false for an internal agent note. Convenience over PUT /tickets/{id}.json.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "zendesk_current_user" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Return the currently authenticated user — a quick way to verify credentials and subdomain. Zendesk REST: GET /users/me.json.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: zendesk_search, zendesk_list_tickets, zendesk_get_ticket, zendesk_list_ticket_comments, zendesk_search_users, zendesk_list_views, zendesk_execute_view, zendesk_list_macros, zendesk_list_ticket_fields, zendesk_get_ticket_metrics · Private data: zendesk_current_user · Public sink: zendesk_search, zendesk_search_users, zendesk_create_ticket · Destructive: zendesk_list_views, zendesk_execute_view.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: zendesk_search, zendesk_list_tickets, zendesk_get_ticket, zendesk_list_ticket_comments, zendesk_search_users, zendesk_list_views, zendesk_execute_view, zendesk_list_macros, zendesk_list_ticket_fields, zendesk_get_ticket_metrics · Private data: zendesk_current_user · Public sink: zendesk_search, zendesk_search_users, zendesk_create_ticket · Destructive: zendesk_list_views, zendesk_execute_view

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
